title: Owner Billing Terms: Progress Billing, Stoppage for Non-Payment and Retainage Release
content:
# Owner Billing Terms — Progress Billing, Stoppage for Non-Payment and Retainage Release

Billing terms of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects. Clauses shown in a quotation block and marked as no longer in force are retained here as the terms formerly stated; the class values they refer to remain values of the class.

## 1. Progress billing

Progress is billed on the class's billing frequency against the class's basis, and the amount earned to a billing is the share of the contract value complete at the period close less everything billed before it. The amount billed to date on a project is the total of its deposit, mobilisation, progress, change order and completion billings from the award day onward.

## 2. Retainage withheld

> The tier's retainage is withheld from every progress and change order billing, not from the deposit or from stored equipment, and it is held until closeout.

This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis. The retainage taken on a billing is the billing amount multiplied by the class's retainage rate, rounded to the nearest cent.

## 3. Due date and late fee

> Each invoice falls due the tier's payment term after the invoice date, counted in calendar days with the invoice day excluded and the due day included, and an invoice unpaid past its due day carries the tier's late fee for each month or part month it stays unpaid.

This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis. The class's payment term and monthly late fee rate remain values of the class; a late fee at the class's monthly rate on an amount is that amount multiplied by the rate, rounded to the nearest cent.

## 4. Stoppage for non-payment

Where a progress billing stays unpaid beyond the class's stoppage period, work on site stops and the class's remobilisation fee is charged when it resumes.

## 5. Retainage release

Retainage is released within the class's release period counted forward in calendar days from the day the system was accepted as running for its intended use, provided the punch list is cleared and the closeout documents are delivered. The day of acceptance is the day recorded on the project as its substantial completion; the release is inside the period when it falls no later than that day plus the class's release period in calendar days, the day plus the full period itself being inside.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, class release period 45 days)

| Day of acceptance | 45th day after it | Release recorded | Inside the period |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a 31-day month | the 15th of the next month | the 15th of the next month | yes, on the boundary day |
| the 1st of a 31-day month | the 15th of the next month | the 16th of the next month | no, one day past it |

## 6. Application of payments

> Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid project invoice unless the owner names one.

This clause is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis.

## Worked illustration of clause 1 (hypothetical)

Contract value USD 300000, 40 per cent complete at the period close, USD 90000 billed before this period: the amount earned to this billing is USD 120000 less USD 90000, USD 30000.
